segments.text:
The least measure of faith that any Christian can haue, is compared to the
graine of mustard seed, the least of all seeds: and to flaxe
that hath fire in it, but so weake that it can neither giue heat nor light, but only maketh a smoke, and is called by the name of a
little faith: and it may bee thus described,
When a man of an humble heart doth not yet feele the assurance of the forgiuenes of his own sinnes, and yet he is perswaded that they are pardonable, desiring that they might be pardoned: and therefore praieth to God, that he would pardon them,
and giue him strength to leaue them.
